crossRefs.note: All we like sheep have gone astray. Everyone has turned to his own way; and Yahweh has laid on him the iniquity of us…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be to you a number of days, even three hundred ninety days. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
translations.bsb: For I have assigned to you 390 days, according to the number of years of their iniquity. So you shall bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
translations.kjv: For I have laid upon thee the years of their iniquity, according to the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
translations.asv: For I have appointed the years of their iniquity to be unto thee a number of days, even three hundred and ninety days: so shalt thou bear the iniquity of the house of Israel.
